# CI/CD Workflows

Workflow files are not included in this template. Copy them from the CI/CD component for your platform of choice:

- **GitHub Actions** — [`components/cicd/github_actions_pipeline/`](../../../../components/cicd/github_actions_pipeline/)
- **Azure DevOps** — [`components/cicd/ado_pipeline/`](../../../../components/cicd/ado_pipeline/) *(if available)*

See the [CI/CD component README](../../../../components/cicd/README.md) for setup instructions, required secrets, and design rationale.
